content: What's a good exercise for my upper chest?

Incline Barbell Press or Incline Dumbbell Press are your best bets for upper chest development, Alex! 💪 The incline angle (30-45°) specifically targets the clavicular head of the pecs. Want me to add either of these to today's workout?
Sounds good, add it to today's workout.
Which one do you want to add — Incline Barbell Press or Incline Dumbbell Press?
